class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Converts between YAML text and Godot data structures.
class.description: Main interface for working with YAML in Godot. [url=https://yaml.org/]YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language)[/url] is a human-friendly data serialization standard commonly used for configuration files, data exchange, and storing structured information in a readable format. This class automatically handles conversion between YAML and standard Godot [Variant] types, except for [Callable] and [RID]. For custom types, you can use [method YAML.register_class] to register a script class for serialization and deserialization.

method.name: allow_resource_path
method.description: Allows resource loading from a specific path prefix for the default security instance. See [method YAMLSecurity.allow_path] for details.

method.name: block_resource_type
method.description: Blocks a specific resource type globally for the default security instance. See [method YAMLSecurity.block_type] for details.

method.name: create_security
method.description: Creates a new [YAMLSecurity] object for controlling resource loading during YAML parsing.

method.name: create_style
method.description: Creates a new [YAMLStyle] object for customizing YAML serialization.

method.name: has_registered_class
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a class with the given name is registered for YAML serialization.

method.name: load_file
method.description: Loads and parses a YAML file from the given [param path]. Returns a [YAMLResult] with data or error information.

method.name: load_file_and_validate
method.description:
Loads a YAML file and validates it against a schema in one operation. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data with validation information or error details.
This is equivalent to [method load_file] followed by validation, but more efficient as it performs both operations together.
The [param schema] parameter can be: - [code]null[/code] or omitted - Auto-discovers schema from [code]$schema[/code] field in YAML - [String] - ID of a registered schema (e.g., [code]"http://example.com/config.yaml"[/code]) - [class Schema] - Direct schema object
If [param security] is provided, it controls resource loading during parsing. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], formatting information is preserved in the result.
[codeblock] # Load game configuration schema var config_schema = YAML.load_schema_from_file("res://schemas/game_config.yaml")
# Load and validate user config file var result = YAML.load_file_and_validate("user://settings.yaml", config_schema)
# Check for file/parse errors if result.has_error(): push_error("Failed to load config: %s" % result.get_error()) create_default_config() return
# Check for validation errors if result.has_validation_errors(): push_warning("Invalid config detected:") print(result.get_validation_summary())
# Use validated data with defaults applied, or fall back var config = result.get_data() if not is_critical_config_valid(config): create_default_config() return
# Config is valid - apply settings apply_game_settings(result.get_data())
# Using auto-discovery with $schema in file result = YAML.load_file_and_validate("user://player_profile.yaml") if not result.has_error() and not result.has_validation_errors(): load_player_profile(result.get_data()) [/codeblock]
[b]See also:[/b] [method load_file], [method parse_and_validate], [method load_schema_from_file]

method.name: load_schema_from_file
method.description:
Loads and parses a YAML schema file, returning a [Schema] object ready for validation. Returns [code]null[/code] if the file cannot be read or contains malformed YAML. This method combines YAML file loading with [method Schema.build_schema] from the [url=https://github.com/fimbul-works/gdschema]GDSchema[/url] extension. Schemas support the full [url=https://json-schema.org/specification-links.html#draft-7]JSON Schema Draft-7[/url] specification. Schemas with a [code]$id[/code] field are automatically registered globally, making them referenceable by ID. This is ideal for loading reusable schema definitions that can be referenced across your project. If [param validate_against_meta] is [code]true[/code], the schema itself is validated against the JSON Schema Draft-7 meta-schema before building. [b]YAML Extension Keywords:[/b] • [code]default[/code] - Provides default values for missing properties • [code]x-yaml-tag[/code] - Validates YAML tags (e.g., [code]!Resource[/code]) [codeblock] # user_schema.yaml # $id: "http://example.com/user.yaml" # type: object # properties: # username: # type: string # minLength: 3 # email: # type: string # format: email # role: # type: string # default: user # x-yaml-tag: UserRole # avatar: # type: string # x-yaml-tag: Resource # required: # - username # - email
# Load the schema var user_schema = YAML.load_schema_from_file("res://schemas/user_schema.yaml") if not user_schema: push_error("Failed to load user schema") return
# Method 1: Validate using the Schema object directly var result = user_schema.validate({ "username": "alice", "email": "alice@example.com" }) if result.has_errors(): print(result.get_summary()) else: print("Valid user data")
# Method 2: Parse and validate YAML using the schema ID var user_yaml = """ username: bob email: bob@example.com role: !UserRole admin avatar: !Resource "res://avatars/bob.png" """ result = YAML.parse_and_validate(user_yaml, "http://example.com/user.yaml") if result.has_validation_errors(): print(result.get_validation_summary()) else: var data = result.get_data() print(data.username) # "bob" print(data.role) # "admin" print(data.avatar) # Texture2D resource
# Method 3: Auto-discovery using $schema field in YAML var user_yaml_with_schema = """ $schema: "http://example.com/user.yaml" username: carol email: carol@example.com """ result = YAML.parse_and_validate(user_yaml_with_schema) if not result.has_validation_errors(): var data = result.get_data() print(data.role) # "user" (default applied) [/codeblock] [b]Advanced Features:[/b] Schemas support [code]$ref[/code] references, definitions ([code]$defs[/code]), logical composition ([code]allOf[/code], [code]anyOf[/code], [code]oneOf[/code], [code]not[/code]), and conditional schemas ([code]if[/code]/[code]then[/code]/[code]else[/code]). [codeblock] # config_schema.yaml with references # $id: "http://example.com/config.yaml" # type: object # properties: # user: # $ref: "http://example.com/user.yaml" # settings: # type: object # properties: # theme: # type: string # default: dark
var config_schema = YAML.load_schema_from_file("res://schemas/config_schema.yaml")
# The schema can reference other registered schemas var config_yaml = """ $schema: "http://example.com/config.yaml" user: username: dave email: dave@example.com settings: {} """ var result = YAML.parse_and_validate(config_yaml) if not result.has_validation_errors(): var data = result.get_data() print(data.user.role) # "user" (default from user schema) print(data.settings.theme) # "dark" (default from config schema) [/codeblock] [b]See also:[/b] [method load_schema_from_string], [method parse_and_validate] [b]Note:[/b] For complete JSON Schema documentation and advanced features, see [url=https://github.com/fimbul-works/gdschema]GDSchema README[/url].

method.name: load_schema_from_string
method.description:
Parses a YAML string and builds a [Schema] object for validation. Returns a [Schema] ready for validation, or [code]null[/code] if the YAML is malformed. This method combines YAML parsing with [method Schema.build_schema] from the [url=https://github.com/fimbul-works/gdschema]GDSchema[/url] extension. Schemas support the full [url=https://json-schema.org/specification-links.html#draft-7]JSON Schema Draft-7[/url] specification, including [code]$ref[/code] references, schema composition ([code]allOf[/code], [code]anyOf[/code], [code]oneOf[/code]), and conditional validation ([code]if[/code]/[code]then[/code]/[code]else[/code]). Schemas with a [code]$id[/code] field are automatically registered globally and can be referenced by ID in other schemas or during validation. If [param validate_against_meta] is [code]true[/code], the schema itself is validated against the JSON Schema Draft-7 meta-schema before building. [b]YAML Extension Keywords:[/b] In addition to standard JSON Schema keywords, two YAML-specific extensions are available: • [code]default[/code] - Provides a default value when a property is [i]missing[/i] (not when explicitly [code]null[/code]) • [code]x-yaml-tag[/code] - Validates that a YAML value has a specific tag (e.g., [code]!Resource[/code], [code]!CustomType[/code]) [codeblock] # Load a schema with definitions, defaults, and tag validation var yaml_schema = """ $id: "http://example.com/user.yaml"
# Reusable definitions $defs: settings: type: object properties: theme: type: string enum: [light, dark, auto] default: dark volume: type: number minimum: 0 maximum: 1 default: 0.5
type: object properties: username: type: string minLength: 3 maxLength: 20 email: type: string format: email role: type: string enum: [user, admin, moderator] default: user x-yaml-tag: UserRole avatar: type: string x-yaml-tag: Resource settings: $ref: "#/$defs/settings" required: - username - email """
var schema = YAML.load_schema_from_string(yaml_schema) if not schema: push_error("Failed to parse schema") return
# Validate data using the schema var valid_data = { "username": "alice", "email": "alice@example.com" } var result = schema.validate(valid_data) print(result.is_valid()) # true print(result.get_data().role) # "user" (default applied) print(result.get_data().settings.theme) # "dark" (nested default)
# Invalid data shows detailed errors var invalid_data = { "username": "ab", # Too short "email": "not-an-email" # Invalid format } result = schema.validate(invalid_data) if result.has_errors(): print(result.get_summary()) # Schema validation failed with 2 error(s): # [1] At '/username': String length 2 is less than minimum 3 (minLength) # [2] At '/email': String "not-an-email" does not match format email (format) [/codeblock] [b]See also:[/b] [method load_schema_from_file], [method parse_and_validate] [b]Note:[/b] For complete JSON Schema documentation, see [url=https://github.com/fimbul-works/gdschema]GDSchema README[/url].

method.name: parse
method.description:
Parses a YAML string into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. If [param security] is provided, it will be used to restrict resource loading during parsing. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], the [YAMLResult] instance will contain a [YAMLStyle] object. See [method YAMLResult.get_style] for details. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var quest_text = """ title: Defeat the Dragon level: 5 rewards: gold: 1000 items: [Dragon Scale, Fire Gem] """
var result = YAML.parse(quest_text) if !result.has_error(): var quest = result.get_data() print("Quest: %s (Level %d)" % [quest.title, quest.level]) else: print("Parse error: %s" % result.get_error()) [/codeblock]

method.name: parse_and_validate
method.description:
Parses a YAML string and validates it against a schema in one operation. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data with validation information or error details.
The [param schema] parameter can be: - [code]null[/code] or omitted - Auto-discovers schema from [code]$schema[/code] field in YAML - [String] - ID of a registered schema (e.g., [code]"http://example.com/config.yaml"[/code]) - [Ref] - Direct schema object
If [param security] is provided, it controls resource loading during parsing. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], formatting information is preserved in the result.
[b]Important:[/b] Always check both [method YAMLResult.has_error] for parse errors and [method YAMLResult.has_validation_errors] for schema validation failures.
[codeblock] # Register a schema with $id var user_schema = YAML.load_schema_from_string(""" $id: "http://example.com/user.yaml" type: object properties: username: type: string minLength: 3 email: type: string format: email required: [username, email] """)
# Parse and validate using schema ID var result = YAML.parse_and_validate(""" username: alice email: alice@example.com """, "http://example.com/user.yaml")
# Check for parse errors first if result.has_error(): push_error("Parse error: %s" % result.get_error()) return
# Then check for validation errors if result.has_validation_errors(): print(result.get_validation_summary()) return
# Both parsing and validation succeeded var user_data = result.get_data() process_user(user_data)
# Auto-discovery using $schema field var yaml_with_schema = """ $schema: "http://example.com/user.yaml" username: bob email: bob@example.com """ result = YAML.parse_and_validate(yaml_with_schema) # No explicit schema needed [/codeblock]
[b]See also:[/b] [method parse], [method load_schema_from_string], [method YAMLResult.get_validation_result]

method.name: register_class
method.description:
Registers a custom script class for YAML serialization and deserialization. It is recommended to do this in an autoloading singleton or a script that runs at the start of your game. [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Define a custom Item resource class class_name Item extends Resource
var name: String var weight: float var value: int
func _init(p_name = "", p_weight = 0.0, p_value = 0): name = p_name weight = p_weight value = p_value
static func deserialize(data): if typeof(data) != TYPE_DICTIONARY: return YAMLResult.error("Item requires a dictionary")
return Item.new( data.get("name", ""), data.get("weight", 0.0), data.get("value", 0) )
func serialize(): return { "name": name, "weight": weight, "value": value }
# Register the class for YAML serialization YAML.register_class(Item, "serialize", "deserialize", "ruby:object/Item") [/codeblock]

method.name: reset_security
method.description: Resets the default security settings to their original state. See [method YAMLSecurity.reset] for details.

method.name: save_file
stringify
method.description:
Converts [param data] to YAML text. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing the generated YAML string or error information. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var spell = { "name": "Fireball", "damage": 45, "mana_cost": 30, "effects": ["Burn", "Light"] }
var result = YAML.stringify(spell) if !result.has_error(): print(result.get_data()) # Output: # name: Fireball # damage: 45 # mana_cost: 30 # effects: # - Burn # - Light [/codeblock]

method.name: try_load_file
try_load_file_and_validate
method.description:
Simplified version of [method load_file_and_validate] that returns the parsed data directly or [code]null[/code] on error. Automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.
The [param schema] parameter can be: - [code]null[/code] or omitted - Auto-discovers schema from [code]$schema[/code] field in YAML - [String] - ID of a registered schema - [Ref] - Direct schema object
[b]Note:[/b] This method returns [code]null[/code] for file errors, parse errors, and validation errors. Use [method load_file_and_validate] if you need to distinguish between error types or access detailed validation information.
[codeblock] # Quick file load with validation var game_config = YAML.try_load_file_and_validate( "user://game_config.yaml", "http://example.com/config.yaml" )
if game_config: apply_configuration(game_config) else: # Error was already logged apply_default_configuration()
# With auto-discovery (schema ID in file) var player_profile = YAML.try_load_file_and_validate("user://profile.yaml") if player_profile: setup_player(player_profile) [/codeblock]
[b]See also:[/b] [method load_file_and_validate], [method try_load_file]

method.name: try_parse
method.description:
Simplified version of [method parse] that returns the parsed data directly, or [code]null[/code] on error. [codeblock lang=gdscript] var data = YAML.try_parse(""" weapon: Axe damage: 25 """)
if data: print("Weapon: %s (Damage: %d)" % [data.weapon, data.damage]) else: print("Failed to parse weapon data") [/codeblock]

method.name: try_parse_and_validate
method.description:
Simplified version of [method parse_and_validate] that returns the parsed data directly or [code]null[/code] on error. Automatically reports errors through Godot's error reporting system.
The [param schema] parameter can be: - [code]null[/code] or omitted - Auto-discovers schema from [code]$schema[/code] field in YAML - [String] - ID of a registered schema - [Ref] - Direct schema object
[b]Note:[/b] This method returns [code]null[/code] for both parse errors and validation errors. Use [method parse_and_validate] if you need to distinguish between error types or access detailed validation information.
[codeblock] # Quick validation with error logging var config_schema = YAML.load_schema_from_string(""" type: object properties: volume: type: number minimum: 0 maximum: 1 default: 0.5 """)
var config = YAML.try_parse_and_validate(""" volume: 0.8 """, config_schema)
if config: apply_audio_settings(config) else: # Errors were already logged use_default_audio_settings()
# With auto-discovery var user_data = YAML.try_parse_and_validate(""" $schema: "http://example.com/user.yaml" username: alice email: alice@example.com """)
if user_data: create_user_account(user_data) [/codeblock]
[b]See also:[/b] [method parse_and_validate], [method try_parse]
